newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast prods flat as traders await supply data.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast prods flat as traders await supply data.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined products were flat early Tuesday, as traders avoided deals until an afternoon inventory report could help them gauge supply, traders said.
Last week's report from the American Petroleum Institute (API0 showed a bearish trend for West Coast gasoline, with gasoline stocks up 98,000 barrels-per-day as of March 28.
The rise helped pushed down prices sharply last week, traders said.
Traders reported CARB gasoline in San Francisco sold for 70.50 cents a gallon Tuesday, in line with Monday's levels.
